newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Good demand seen at Brazil govt coffee auction.
newsitem.headline: Good demand seen at Brazil govt coffee auction.

text.p: An auction of 120,100 60-kg bags of Brazilian government coffee stocks was seeing good demand, with prices well above opening levels, said an official at Banco do Brasil, which was holding the electronic sale.
"There is a lot of interest, a lot of competition," the official said.
The auction began on 1400 local/1600 GMT. By 1600 local/1800 GMT, 108,351 bags had been sold which represented 100 percent of the coffee offered by that stage, the official said.
The coffee was mainly from the 1987/88 harvest, with the bulk coming from the states of Sao Paulo and Parana.
